title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to view an affected container could query…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to view a container can access the REST API to retrieve a live external prompt link for approvals belonging to other users. This link allows reading and responding to approval prompts without further authentication, potentially disrupting automated workflows.
